name: NGC 3501 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 3501, an edge-on spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc3501-hubble
story: Seen edge-on, this spiral galaxy is a narrow slice of stars, mottled by the dust lanes that trace across it. Its loosely wound arms all spring from its center, with no bar.

claims.text: NGC 3501 appears edge-on, elongated and very narrow
Dust lanes trace across the galaxy
Its loosely wound arms originate from its center, with no bar
ESA/Hubble titled its image of NGC 3501 "A slice of stars"
